places.name: Hat Creek cow camp
places.note: Brush camp where the herd is held and branded; Bolivar's snake stew upsets Jasper; Jake declines the drive and Augustus suggests bringing Lorie.
places.location_hint: a long valley near the Rio Grande, about five miles from Lonesome Dove, out in the brush

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Each night Call crosses it with a few hands to bring back Mexican longhorns; he rides toward it for the last drag.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Source of the two or three hundred wild cattle taken each night; Jake won't ride there tonight.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Augustus spent the day there; Jake leaves camp to ride back to it.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande, about five miles from the cow camp

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Jake says he may stay there instead; Augustus doubts Lorie wants to go back where she came from.

places.name: San Francisco
places.note: Augustus reports Lorie is eager to go there.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Jake, who called it a cowman's paradise, now balks at the drive; Call hopes to start north Monday.

places.name: Kansas
places.note: No one in the outfit has been farther north than this.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: Jake reckons the drive at least beats hanging there.

places.name: Denver
places.note: Augustus suggests stopping there; Jake wishes he had gone there rather than Fort Smith.

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: Jake regrets having gone there instead of Denver.

groups.label: Night raiding party
groups.hint: riding from the cow camp to the river to cross into Mexico for a last drag of cattle

groups.label: Cow camp
groups.hint: holding the herd in a valley near the river about five miles from town

groups.label: Jake Spoon
groups.hint: riding from the cow camp back to town
